title: Ministry of Environment Act, 2018 (35 MIRC Ch. 6)
citation: Ministry of Environment Act, 2018, P.L. 2019-108, 35 MIRC Ch. 6
evidence: Header of the Nitijela PDF (https://rmiparliament.org/cms/images/LEGISLATION/PRINCIPAL/2019/2019-0108/2019-0108_1.pdf): "Commencement: October 2, 2019 Source: P.L. 2019-108"; opened 2026-11-09. Section 624 says nothing takes effect until three months after the date of enactment, so the header date is the date the publisher prints, not a computed one.
notes: Sets up the Ministry of Environment and a Climate Change Directorate (s.613) and requires climate-proofing (s.615). The brief gave P.L. 2019-1602 and Act 2019-1082 from a search summary; the PDF prints P.L. 2019-108, so those numbers are dropped. Text link only: the Nitijela site carries a footer 'All Rights Reserved' and no reuse terms (row MH-NITIJELA-MIRC, permission requested).

title: Consumer Protection Act (20 MIRC Ch. 4)
citation: Consumer Protection Act, 33 TTC 1970 as amended (33 TTC 1980, P.L. 1991-131, P.L. 1997-46, P.L. 1997-48), 20 MIRC Ch. 4
evidence: Header of the Nitijela PDF (https://rmiparliament.org/cms/images/LEGISLATION/PRINCIPAL/1970/1970-0032/1970-0032_1.pdf): "Commencement: Not Specified Source: 33 TTC 1970"; opened 2026-11-09. The Nitijela list shows 01 January 1970 as a placeholder date, not read as a commencement.
notes: Umbrella consumer law. The text was searched for 'misleading', 'deceptive' and 'false' and has no environmental-claims provision; family F6 is the general consumer-law umbrella, not a greenwashing rule. The brief said a consumer protection act was not found; it exists as 20 MIRC Ch. 4. Text link only (row MH-NITIJELA-MIRC, permission requested).

title: Unfair Business Practices Act (20 MIRC Ch. 3)
